channel.title: The Grant Desk - Open Calls, Design, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Open Calls, Design, EU, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 1 new grant - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
1 new grant landed on The Grant Desk in the week of 17 Aug 2026 (17 Aug to 23 Aug 2026).

  • Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven: Project Subsidy (Projecten, 2027 round 1)
    Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 35,000 per application and maximum 80 percent of eligible costs, so at least 20 percent co-financing is required. No application fee.
